_README: THE BUILDER ROSTER AND EVERY WORD ON A BUILDER PAGE LIVES HERE.
Ranee, 2026-09-21: 'I want to add photos as we go along.' This file is how.
Edit it, run `python3 tools/build-builders.py`, commit. That regenerates the
builder cards on the home page, the Panorama Builders page, and every
find-a-home/builder-<slug>.html. Nothing on a builder page is hand-written.
THE FIELDS ARE RANEE'S BUILDER ASSET GUIDE, 1:1. A field left null renders
as a visible 'pending' marker naming what is missing -- it is NEVER filled
with plausible copy. The pages shipped before 2026-09-21 carried invented
floor plans ('The Vista, 4 beds, up to 3,600 sq ft') that no builder ever
supplied; that is what this file exists to make impossible.
NO FLOOR PLANS AND NO LOT ASSIGNMENTS. Ranee, 2026-09-21: 'We're not gonna
have any floor plans on the whole thing. No floor plans, no specific lots
for each builder. We're not gonna tell them where their lots are.' There is
deliberately no field for either. Do not add one.
NO LEAD CAPTURE. 'We're not gonna take tours. We're not gonna schedule
tours. We're not gonna do any kind of lead generation.' The only call to
action on a builder page is the link out to that builder's own website.

builders.intro: For over 30 years, McArthur Homes has been building thoughtfully designed homes and communities throughout Utah. As a local, family-owned builder, we’re committed to quality construction, lasting value, and a straightforward homebuying experience, creating homes designed for the way Utah families live today.
homes: Homes at Panorama will feature a collection of thoughtfully designed single-family floor plans with spacious, functional layouts made for everyday living. With a variety of two-story designs, buyers can choose a home that fits their lifestyle, with flexible spaces for gathering, working, entertaining, and relaxing.

Open-concept main living areas create a natural connection between the kitchen, dining, and family spaces, while generous bedrooms, storage, and versatile rooms provide plenty of space to make each home your own. Select plans offer features such as main-level bedrooms, home offices, lofts, and additional living spaces, giving buyers flexibility as their needs change.

Each home at Panorama will combine McArthur Homes’ quality construction with attractive architectural details and opportunities for personalization. From exterior selections to interior finishes and available structural options, buyers can create a home that feels distinctly their own while enjoying the benefits of a thoughtfully planned new-home community.
differentiators: Thoughtfully Designed Floor Plans – Functional layouts designed around the way homeowners live, gather, work, and entertain today.
Personalization Opportunities – Choose from a variety of interior finishes, exterior color schemes, and available structural options to make your home feel like your own.
Spacious Single-Family Homes – A collection of versatile home designs offering generous living spaces, bedrooms, storage, and flexible-use areas.
Open-Concept Living – Welcoming kitchens and gathering spaces are designed to feel connected, comfortable, and functional for everyday life.
Flexible Spaces – Select floor plans offer options such as home offices, lofts, additional bedrooms, and other adaptable spaces to fit changing needs.
Local, Experienced Builder – McArthur Homes brings more than 30 years of homebuilding experience in Utah to every home at Panorama.
Guided Homebuilding Experience – From selecting a homesite and floor plan through design selections and construction, our team helps guide buyers through each step of building their new home.

_assetGuide: THE FIELDS BELOW ARE RANEE'S 'BUILDER ASSET REQUEST' FLYER, 1:1.
BuilderAssets_Flyer_8.5x11_PAN_1.pdf, emailed 2026-09-21. She sends it to
each builder; their reply fills one object here. Keeping the shapes identical
is the whole trick -- a reply arrives in her field names, not ours.
1 Logos ............ logo (vector .ai/.eps/.svg preferred, transparent,
horizontal AND vertical if they have both)
2 Photography ...... exteriorImages / interiorImages, 1-5 each, 300 DPI,
horizontal preferred, min 6x4in
3 Marketing copy ... intro (<=50 words) - homes (2-4 paras, ~150 words,
SPECIFICALLY what they build at Panorama) -
differentiators (4-8 bullets) - url (+ utm)
4 Model homes ...... modelHomes[]: address, grandOpening (date AND time),
opensToPublic, estimatedCompletion
5 Delivery ......... assets go to Ranee@DAIUtah.com
6 Contact .......... contact{name,email,phone}
⛔ `contact` IS INTERNAL AND IS NEVER RENDERED. It is the builder's MARKETING
CONTACT, collected so Ranee can chase assets -- not a number for the public.
tools/build-builders.py must not read it, and lib tests pin that.
⛔ NOTHING BELOW IS FILLED IN YET. The flyer is the REQUEST; no builder has
replied. Every field stays null until their reply lands, and renders as a
marker naming what is missing.
